text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While in the cafeteria, I overhear Meisho<n>Дото
discussing something with<n>Manhattan Cafe and
Yukino Bijin.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text: Um, sooo... about this photo...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'm just going to take a look.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that build'n kinda looks like my<n>fam'ly home.
Makes me feel all fuzzy<n>inside...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text:
I heard this wonderful old<n>Japanese-style house
was built many<n>decades ago, so I took a photo of
it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's blurry... but I can make out a girl in a<n>kimono
with a bob cut.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text: E-e-exactly! But I'm certain there wasnobody there when I took the photo!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This girl... She's looking right at us.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text: I knooow!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text:
D-do you think I've been cursed for<n>taking this
photo?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But looks like she's smil'n to me, so I<n>reck'n you'll
be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B'sides, she doesn't look like the<n>vengeful type or
anything. Don't worry<n>'bout it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text: R-really? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All sortsa odd stuff happened at my old<n>home,
but I was always taught that<n>noth'n bad'll happen
if I behave!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes I heard the sound of<n>footsteps comin'
from an empty room or<n>saw flashes of blue light,
but I wouldn't<n>let any of it spook me one bit! I still<n>
don't!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you behave yourself, you say... Hehe...<n>That's
just like you, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Beings from the other side are drawn to<n>
kindhearted souls... So I'm sure that...<n>Oh, see,
there's another one... beside<n>Дото...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaagh! Am... Am I beyond saving?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My eyes meet with Meisho Дото's as she<n>trembles
in fear.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text: Ohh... I'm sorry for causing such a fuss.
choice_data_list:
It's amazing how these two are totally fine with
ghosts...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text: Th-they really are!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: C'mon now, you're gonna be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Long as you don't go provoking 'em,<n>they won't
do anyth'n to you. They're<n>just like bumblebees!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's right. And perhaps... the ghosts<n>are just as
afraid of us, the living...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yukino isn't afraid... That makes her easy<n>to talk
to.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, hearing that sure puts a grin<n>on my
face! Let's chew all the fat you<n>fancy!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Have you had any other... supernatural<n>
experiences?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This one time, when I was play'n up in<n>the
mountains, I heard a child laugh'n<n>beside me even
though nobody else was<n>about.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And this other time, when it was snow'n<n>pretty
heavy, I saw a lady with a<n>traditional braided hat,
stand'n real still.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! At this point the only thing I'm<n>not afraid
of is is a tanuki!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Дото
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! This stuff is way too scary for<n>small talk!
